title: 第21章 邢佐第22章 道别
content_zh:
众人惊奇发现乌云之下不知何时有了一柄闪烁着青光的长剑巨剑，它立在那里并不断的释放法力波动，刚才的飓风便是由此剑所形成
眼看灵堂大棚就要飞走此时凭空一道道水流汇聚而成的大手将之又按了回去接着天空中响起一道苍老而浑厚的声音
“前辈远道而来就为砸了我宗长老灵堂不成？
未见其人却有一把闪烁着金光的拂尘同样悬于半空，两件法宝顿时碰撞在一起迸发出的威能震慑八方
然那巨剑的主人明显没有收手的打算，剑身一转斩出一道月牙冲击波将拂尘振飞老远
“咳咳……
似受到法宝损伤波及拂尘主人轻哼出声，随后只见半空中闪现一名须发皆白慈眉善目的老者，他身穿一身紫色精美长袍，身手一招那拂尘便落入他手中
当即下方青云宗弟子们便齐齐扣手跪拜，这老者名为李符来头不小乃是青云宗十位实权长老之一修为已达恐怖的金丹期，没想到今日也来了此地
“邢前辈如此对老夫出手难道是要与我青云宗为敌”
李符望着柄还在泛着青光的巨剑嗔怒中带着几分敬畏，他显然认出了法器的主人
“老鬼怎么死的？
一道浑厚的声音从四面八方传来那人丝毫没给李长老面子
而下方的顾鹏早已带领着族人鞠躬礼拜
“恭迎邢叔父”
只见在他身前闪烁出一名身材魁梧披着兜帽的壮汉，他有着浓眉大眼露出的腹部肌肉如同山峦
看见来人顾鹏上前一步眼中含着泪就要跪下
“刑伯父，干爹他……
不等他跪下男人的手臂已经拖住了他
“贤侄不必如此，我都知道，今日我只想讨个公道，活要见人死要见尸！
说罢男人一招手整个灵堂震动摆放中央的棺材爆开里面空无一物

“青云宗杨金莲长老之位……
男人看着黑木灵位上刻着金色的字迹，冷漠的眼神中闪过一丝不易察觉的哀伤
“住手！
刑前辈你这般大闹灵堂是在羞辱我宗颜面”
一道水流化作老者模样朝他怒喝，李符身为实权长老在自己宗门地盘岂能任人践踏
“你想死？
男人只冷冷瞥了一眼，李符顿时站住身子不再多言，眼前之人真不是他惹的起的
众人皆是哗然
“他是天剑门的道子邢佐！
有人当场便猜出了他的身份
天剑门综合实力在整个大赵都是数一数二的，刑佐更是老宗主钦点的下一任接班人，据说其已经跨过金丹这道槛成就了元婴
他与杨金莲，顾青松是生死至交，三人很早便相识了，互相帮扶下在各自宗门一路披荆斩棘从无名小卒到名扬天下
今日刑佐来势汹汹大闹灵堂便是要弄清楚自己好兄弟究竟是怎么死的
奈何青云宗这边说的都是官话，套话，一句采药途中被魔修袭击便匆匆了事，对于这个结果刑佐自然不会接受
能亲眼目睹元婴大修出手是很难得的，只是闹的如此之大，青云宗那边恐怕不会善罢甘休
果然不多时便见两道身影出现半空，一人是青衣老者，一人儒雅中年
现场一片寂静
两人出现后杨威内心涌起一股无名之火，这两人一人是青云宗太上长老李博然，一人是青云宗少宗主李溢
“刑道友莫非不知魔道红月教派崩灭之事？
李博然抚着修长的山羊胡笑着问道
content_en:
Everyone was surprised to find that there was a long sword flashing with green light under the dark clouds. It stood there and continuously released mana fluctuations. The hurricane just now was caused by this sword.
Seeing that the mourning hall tent was about to fly away, a big hand formed by water flowing out of thin air pressed it back, and then an old and deep voice sounded in the sky.
"Senior, why didn't you come all the way just to smash up our sect's elder mourning hall?
He didn't see him, but there was a whisk with glittering golden light hanging in the air. The two magic weapons suddenly collided together, and the power they erupted shocked everyone.
However, the owner of the giant sword obviously had no intention of stopping. The sword turned and slashed out a crescent shock wave that sent the fly whisk flying far away.
"Ahem...
The owner of the whisk seemed to have been damaged by a magic weapon and hummed softly. Then he saw an old man with white beard and hair flashing in the air. He was wearing an exquisite purple robe. With one move, the whisk fell into his hand.
Immediately, the disciples of the Qingyun Sect below all clasped their hands and knelt down to worship. This old man's name was Li Fu, and he was one of the ten powerful elders of the Qingyun Sect. His cultivation had reached the terrifying golden elixir stage. He didn't expect that he would also come here today.
"Senior Xing, by attacking me like this, is he trying to become an enemy of our Qingyun Sect?"
Li Fu looked at the giant sword with a green handle still glowing with anger and awe. He obviously recognized the owner of the magical weapon.
"How did the old ghost die?
A deep voice came from all directions. The man did not give Elder Li any face.
Gu Peng below had already led his tribe to bow in worship.
"Welcome Uncle Xing"
I saw a tall, hooded man flashing in front of him. He had thick eyebrows and big eyes, and his exposed abdominal muscles were like mountains.
When he saw the person coming, Gu Peng took a step forward and was about to kneel down with tears in his eyes.
"Uncle Xing, godfather...
Before he could kneel down, the man's arms had already dragged him down.
"My dear nephew, you don't have to be like this. I already know that. Today, I just want to seek justice. I want to see people live and die, or see corpses!"
After saying that, the man waved his hand and the entire mourning hall shook. The coffin placed in the center exploded and there was nothing inside.
"The position of Elder Yang Jinlian of Qingyun Sect...
The man looked at the golden writings engraved on the black wood spiritual tablet, and a trace of imperceptible sadness flashed in his cold eyes.
"Stop!
Senior Xing, you are humiliating our sect by making such a fuss in the mourning hall."
A stream of water transformed into an old man and shouted angrily at him. As a powerful elder, how could Li Fu let anyone trample on his sect's territory?
"You want to die?
The man only glanced coldly. Li Fu immediately stopped and said nothing. The person in front of him was really not his fault.
Everyone is in an uproar
"He is Xing Zuo, the disciple of Tianjian Sect!
Someone guessed his identity on the spot
The comprehensive strength of Tianjian Sect is one of the best in the entire Zhao Dynasty, and Xing Zuo is the next successor appointed by the old sect leader. It is said that he has crossed the threshold of golden elixir and achieved Nascent Soul.
He, Yang Jinlian, and Gu Qingsong are close friends in life and death. The three of them have known each other for a long time. With the help of each other, they have overcome obstacles in their respective sects from being unknown to becoming famous all over the world.
The reason why Xing Zuo came so aggressively today and made a fuss in the mourning hall was to find out how his good brother died.
However, what the Qingyun Sect said here were all official and cliche. They just said that they were attacked by demon cultivators while collecting medicine and then the matter was over in a hurry. Naturally, Xing Zuo would not accept this result.
It's rare to see Yuanying Daxiu take action with your own eyes, but if the commotion is so big, Qingyun Sect may not let it go.
Sure enough, not long after, two figures appeared in the air, one was an old man in green clothes, and the other was an elegant middle-aged man.
There was silence
After the two people appeared, an unknown fire surged in Yang Wei's heart. One of these two people was Li Boran, the supreme elder of Qingyun Sect, and the other was Li Yi, the young master of Qingyun Sect.
"Does Fellow Daoist Xing not know about the collapse of the Demonic Red Moon Sect?
Li Boran asked with a smile while stroking his slender goatee.
